# Zelvior DevKit

> Everything developers need. Nothing they don't.
> 41 fast, privacy-first developer utilities running 100% locally in the browser with zero cloud telemetry.

## System Overview
- **Name**: Zelvior DevKit
- **Developer**: Zelvior Labs
- **License**: MIT
- **Architecture**: 100% Client-Side Single Page Application & Progressive Web App (PWA)
- **Persistence**: Browser-isolated IndexedDB only (`zelvior_devkit_db`). Zero `localStorage`, zero `sessionStorage`, zero cookies.
- **Security Policy**: Zero server network transmission. Sensitive secrets (JWTs, private keys, HMAC secrets, passwords) are held strictly in transient component memory and never persisted.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/zelvior/devkit

## Utility Categories & Tools (41 Total)

### 1. JSON & Data Tools
- **JSON Formatter & Validator**: Beautify, validate, format, and parse JSON with customizable 2-space, 4-space, or tab indentation.
- **JSON Minifier**: Compress JSON payloads into single-line minified strings removing whitespace.
- **CSV to JSON Converter**: Convert tabular comma/semicolon/tab delimited data into valid JSON objects or arrays.
- **JSON to CSV Converter**: Flatten and export nested or flat JSON arrays into CSV format.
- **XML to JSON Converter**: Parse XML structures into normalized JSON trees.
- **JSON to XML Converter**: Convert JSON objects into compliant XML markup.
- **YAML to JSON Converter**: Translate YAML configuration blocks into JSON.
- **JSON to YAML Converter**: Translate JSON structures into clean YAML documents.

### 2. Text & Code Diffing Tools
- **Text & Code Diff**: Side-by-side and unified diff viewer highlighting additions, deletions, and line-by-line differences.
- **String Case Converter**: Convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, and Title Case.
- **String Inspector & Counter**: Count characters, words, sentences, lines, bytes, and estimate reading time.
- **URL Slug Generator**: Transform strings into clean, SEO-friendly, URL-safe slug strings with custom delimiters.

### 3. Encoding & Decoding Tools
- **Base64 Encoder & Decoder**: Encode and decode standard and URL-safe Base64 strings.
- **URL Encoder & Decoder**: Encode URI components and decode percent-encoded query parameters.
- **HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder**: Escape and unescape HTML special characters (`&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`).
- **Hex to Text & Text to Hex**: Bidirectional hexadecimal encoding and decoding.
- **Unicode & ASCII Inspector**: Inspect Unicode code points, hex values, UTF-8 byte representations, and glyph details.
- **JWT Token Debugger**: Decode and inspect JSON Web Token headers, payloads, expirations, and claims 100% offline without sending tokens to any server.

### 4. Security & Cryptography Tools
- **Cryptographic Hash Generator**: Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, and MD5 hashes using the W3C Web Cryptography API.
- **HMAC Generator**: Generate keyed-hash message authentication codes (HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA512) locally.
- **Password Generator**: Generate high-entropy, cryptographically strong random passwords using `crypto.getRandomValues()`.
- **UUID v4 Generator**: Generate RFC 4122 compliant version 4 UUIDs in bulk.
- **RSA Keypair Generator**: Generate RSA public/private keypairs (2048-bit and 4096-bit) directly in-browser.

### 5. Web Development Tools
- **Sitemap.xml Generator**: Visual builder to construct compliant XML sitemaps with priority, changefreq, and lastmod fields.
- **URL Parser & Query Inspector**: Parse URLs into protocol, hostname, port, pathname, hash, and interactive query parameter tables.
- **Meta Tag & OpenGraph Generator**: Generate Google SEO, OpenGraph (Facebook/LinkedIn), and Twitter card meta tags with live previews.
- **HTTP Status Code Directory**: Searchable reference of all RFC HTTP status codes (1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) with descriptions.
- **User-Agent Inspector**: Parse and analyze browser User-Agent strings locally.

### 6. CSS & Visual Design Tools
- **CSS Minifier & Formatter**: Clean, optimize, format, or compress CSS stylesheets.
- **CSS Box Shadow Generator**: Visually craft layered CSS box shadows with interactive sliders and instant CSS copy.
- **Color Converter & Palette**: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV with luminosity indicators.
- **Flexbox Playground**: Interactive visual flexbox container and item layout simulator.

### 7. Time & Scheduling Tools
- **Unix Epoch Timestamp Converter**: Convert Unix seconds/milliseconds to human-readable ISO/UTC dates and vice versa.
- **Cron Schedule Parser**: Explain 5-part and 6-part cron expressions in plain English with future run date calculations.
- **Timezone Calculator**: Compare and convert times across global timezones (UTC, EST, PST, GMT, CET, JST, etc.).

### 8. Developer Utilities
- **UNIX Chmod Calculator**: Interactive permissions grid calculating octal (e.g., 755, 644) and symbolic (rwxr-xr-x) permissions.
- **Markdown Live Previewer**: Real-time GitHub-flavored Markdown editor with instant live rendered preview.
- **Regex Tester**: Test regular expressions with instant flag matching (g, i, m, s, u) and capture group extraction.
- **SQL Query Formatter**: Format and beautify complex SQL queries across standard dialects.
